name: Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.
summary: Slévárna Vrbenský is a family-owned Czech foundry (150 staff, about 8.3 M EUR turnover) that supplies 25 % of our volute casing HI 80-250. Its scorecard has slid from green to red within a year (OTD 91.7 % against a 95 % target, ppm 5,682, one 8D still open). In April 2026 it commissioned a moulding line that doubles its stainless capacity, and it now needs volume to fill it.

situation.decision_maker: owner / managing director (family firm, no group parent)

negotiation_pattern: Opens with small increase asks (+0.6 %, +1.2 %) or a modest cut (-2.5 %). It settles on average 2.3 points below its ask: -1.7 %, 0.0 % and -5.9 %. It has accepted reductions in 2 of 3 renewals, so it concedes on price rather than walking away.
wants: more volume or quota share to fill the new moulding line
faster payment (it asked for 10-day payment against a cash discount)
keeping Hollerau as a reference customer
protects: tooling (supplier-owned, a lever for keeping the part)
large unit_price drops without a volume or payment trade-off

trades.give: volume_per_year up (quota from 25 % toward 35-40 %), conditional on quality recovery
trades.get: unit_price -3 to -5 % plus ppm_commitment ≤2,500 and OTD ≥95 %
trades.why: The new line doubles capacity, so volume is worth more to it than margin, and the current red score justifies tying share to quality.

trades.give: payment_days shortened to 10 days (with skonto) or at least strict on-time payment
trades.get: skonto ≥2 % or an equivalent unit_price reduction
trades.why: It asked for exactly this. We currently pay late 92 % of the time and take no skonto, so this is cheap goodwill.

trades.get: 2027 price held or reduced, plus chargeback_eur_per_complaint raised from 150 to ~500
trades.why: Longer security suits a family firm that has just invested in capacity, and the current flat fee of 150 EUR has no bite.

arguments.point: The scorecard fell from green to red (OTD 100 → 91.7 %, ppm 2,874 → 5,682). OTD is below the contractual 95 % target, and share depends on recovery.
We already have a second source for this part, so quota can shift either way.
The new moulding line needs loading, and we can offer growth (spend up from 152k to 199k EUR since FY2024).
It called Hollerau an important reference customer, so keeping and growing the account matters to it.
Prices are fixed per calendar year, and any change needs 90 days' notice before year end (around 2 Oct). If no notice arrives, 2027 prices stay at 559.61 by default.

avoid: Hard price pressure without offering volume or payment in return, because a family firm digs in.
Threatening to pull the whole part: it owns the tooling and we have only one alternative source.
Ignoring our own late payment (92 % late, 5.5 days on average). It will raise it if we lean on its OTD.
tone: Respectful and partnership-oriented, signed personally. Be firm and factual on quality numbers, and frame offers as growing together.
red_flags: Quality and delivery are deteriorating, possibly from the new-line ramp-up. One 8D is open, and the last complaint was on 2026-08-26.
The payment request suggests some liquidity strain after the capex, although the credit index (239) and equity ratio (36.4 %) are stable.
Tooling is supplier-owned, which makes resourcing slow.

evidence.claim: Scorecard trend: green (85.6) → amber (80.6) → red (67.4, class C); OTD 91.7 %, ppm 5,682.
Contract OTD target is 95 %, with a flat fee of 150 EUR per complaint.
A new automatic moulding line doubles its stainless casting capacity.
It asked for payment within 10 days in exchange for a cash discount.
It calls Hollerau an important reference customer.
Past renewals settled below its ask: +0.6 → -1.7 %, +1.2 → 0 %, -2.5 → -5.9 %.
Current price is 559.61 EUR, below its 2025 RFQ quote of 598.10 EUR.
The framework runs to 2027-06-30, auto-extends 12 months, and has a 90-day notice period.

indicators.credit_index: 239 (12 months ago 239; higher is worse, >300 weak)
indicators.scorecard_trend: 2025Q4 green (otd 100.0, ppm 2959) → 2026Q1 green (otd 100.0, ppm 2874) → 2026Q2 amber (otd 91.3, ppm 3003) → 2026Q3 red (otd 91.7, ppm 5682)
